# TechGeek.uz

TechGeek.uz is an independent smart-gadget seller serving Tashkent and customers across Uzbekistan.
The store sells original devices, provides an authenticity guarantee, and offers a one-month warranty for manufacturing defects.
Website prices are retail prices per unit. Wholesale pricing for a batch is available on request by phone or Telegram.

## Contact

- Telegram: https://t.me/techgeek_uz
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/techgeek.uz/
- Service area: Tashkent and Uzbekistan
- Languages: Russian and Uzbek
